package.name: realFluidFoam-8
package.provenance: archive of the pinned commit downloaded from github; never extracted on a case-insensitive filesystem
package.local_modifications: none; built exactly as upstream ships

build.output_layout_note: profile-specific directories override FOAM_USER_APPBIN and FOAM_USER_LIBBIN so the package cannot write into either the stock platform directories or the user's ambient ~/.OpenFOAM tree

stock_separation.claim: the stock OpenFOAM-8 installation is unchanged by this build
stock_separation.verification: md5 of four stock artefacts measured before and after the realFluid build; all four identical
stock_separation.note: the package installs libraries with the same SONAMES as stock (libcombustionModels, libspecie, libreactionThermophysicalModels, ...), so library identity at runtime is decided by LD_LIBRARY_PATH order, not by the executable path. The profile env puts the profile library directory first; ldd confirms the effect below.
